question: Who among the following is a Choreographer in Indian film Industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prabhu Deva**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prabhu Deva** is a renowned choreographer in the Indian film industry.
 
• He has choreographed numerous songs across various Indian languages, earning him significant acclaim.
 
• In addition to choreography, Prabhu Deva is also known for his work as a film director, producer, and actor.
 
• His contributions to dance and choreography have earned him several awards, including the National Film Award for Best Choreography.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anu Malik** is a music director and singer in the Indian film industry.
 
• **Pritam** is a music composer and record producer known for his work in Bollywood.
 
• **Arijit Singh** is a playback singer and music programmer, highly popular for his singing in Hindi films.
 
• Choreographers in the Indian film industry play a crucial role in designing and directing dance sequences in movies.
 
• Choreography in Indian cinema is a blend of various dance styles, including classical, contemporary, and folk dances.
